query: Which causal inference designs (matched pairs, diff-in-diff, interrupted time series, propensity scoring, hierarchical models) are most robust for estimating informal shade effects?

response.query: Which causal inference designs (matched pairs, diff-in-diff, interrupted time series, propensity scoring, hierarchical models) are most robust for estimating informal shade effects?
response.answer: Interrupted time series and diff-in-diff designs are most robust for estimating informal shade effects. Propensity scoring and hierarchical models can also be effective.
